item.title: Woman accused of killing 14-year-old girl in Rock County
item.description: UPDATE: A death investigation is underway after the Rock County Sheriff's Office responded to a welfare check on Friday morning, March 20, in the 2000 block of East Gorton Street in the Town of Turtle.

item.title: Child neglect charges after unattended child found in Janesville
item.description: Four people were arrested in Janesville, Wisconsin after a child was found wandering alone in a diaper, leading to the discovery of concerning living conditions in the child's home and two people with outstanding warrants hiding in the basement.

item.title: Man accused of placing hidden camera in women's dressing room at TJ Maxx
item.description: A former employee of the Machesney Park TJ Maxx store has been accused of placing a camera in the women's dressing room.

item.title: Dixon man, wanted for attempted murder, caught in wig disguise on bicycle during police chase
item.description: A man, wanted for attempted murder, was caught by police while allegedly wearing a wig and running from officers on a bicycle.

item.title: Rockford has one of Illinois’ highest sex offender rates, analysis shows
item.description: The city of Rockford has about one registered sex offender for every 211 residents, a ratio higher than the Illinois statewide average

item.title: Rockford NAACP branch petitioning for west-side grocery store
item.description: The Rockford branch of the NAACP is campaigning to bring a new grocery store to the city's west side to address what they say is a lack of healthy food options in the area.

item.title: Keith Country Day School wins first-ever state title in quiz bowl
item.description: A group of students at Keith Country Day School placed first in the IHSA state championships for a scholastic bowl over the weekend. It is the first time they won state.

item.title: Teenager shot in leg at Rockford's Auburn Manor
item.description: An 18-year-old suffered a gunshot wound to the leg at Rockford's Auburn Manor housing complex on Monday night, according to police.

item.title: Rockford committee advances update to 2040 Future Land Use Map
item.description: The Rockford Planning and Development Committee voted to advance an update to the city's 2040 Future Land Use Map, which includes a broader allocation of industrial land, despite public concerns over environmental impacts and farmland conversion.
